patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Ocean.io only if your buying job matches “Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/cr” rather than 6sense's shape. Choose 6sense only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritizati” rather than Ocean.io's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Ocean.io is shaped for Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichme whereas 6sense is shaped for Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, . Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Ocean.io and 6sense share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Ocean.io is Lookalike / similar-company prospecting with credit waterfall enrichment — from ~$0.063/credit, ~$47/mo yearly headline.; 6sense is Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account prioritization, and revenue-team orchestration — custom-quote .
- Company-size focus: Ocean.io (small-business, mid-market) vs 6sense (mid-market, enterprise).
- Researched limits: Ocean.io — Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; 6sense — Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote.

Limitations — Ocean.io: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer; Credit minimums and yearly packaging require modeling before comparing to seat tools; 6sense: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote; Enterprise ABM / predictive stack carries material implementation and admin overhead.

Poor-fit cases: Ocean.io is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Lookalike/similar-company specialist — not a full contact mega-database or sequencer · 6sense is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat and module prices are not published — packaging is custom quote · Avoid Ocean.io if you actually need 6sense's motion (Enterprise ABM and sales intelligence platform for predictive intent, account pr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
